canonical_project: ICT Group JSC Tier III data centre
notes: Haskoning project page says ICT Group JSC was opening a new Tier III-standard data centre in Mongolia in 2022 and already operated two data centres; DCD later referred to ICT Group as previously developing a facility. Public sources reviewed did not confirm current operating status or a more specific city location, but Mongolia's market evidence is concentrated around Ulaanbaatar.
